name: Nagakura Shinpachi
source:
Hobby: Practicing with Serizawa Kamo

This leader of team two of the Shinsengumi is known as "Desperate Shin" for his diligence. He is so crazy about working out that he will even feel uncomfortable without the sound of wielding bokken.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/baku.html]English official site[/url]]
